items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is an interview with Frank Chase. My name is John Steiner.

ctx.x: Oh, I... He had a beautiful, clean style and everything, but... He seemed to be almost isolated.
This is an interview with Frank Chase. My name is John Steiner. This is Saturday, maybe the 18th of... Is it the 18th? About 18th of November 19th.
